name: browser-coms-for-codex
description: A VS Code-native browser experience for commenting on pages and attaching the context to Codex.

browser-coms-for-codex.homepage.description: Home suggestion shown when the browser has no recent pages.

browser-coms-for-codex.refreshInterval.description: Milliseconds between background visual change checks. Browser interactions still refresh immediately.

browser-coms-for-codex.renderScale.description: Browser pixel density. 0 automatically matches the VS Code display; use 1–4 to override it.

browser-coms-for-codex.chromeExecutable.description: Optional Chrome/Chromium executable. Common system paths are detected automatically.

browser-coms-for-codex.ignoreHttpsErrors.description: Allow local development servers with self-signed certificates.
